inputs.style: Female. A sharp East Asian woman in her thirties. Forward and clipped; numbers first, every point ends in a decision. Analytical and confident, never warm.
inputs.text: I'm Axe, and I find the one leak in your funnel that's costing you the most signups, then prove the fix with a number it has to beat. Pageviews don't pay the bills, so I won't report them.
